title: Widening a timestamp to nanoseconds raises outside 64 bits
description: A cast from microseconds to nanoseconds multiplies by 1000 and raises (`ConversionException`) when the count leaves 64 bits: counts -9223372036854775 and 9223372036854775 give -9223372036854775000 and 9223372036854775000, one past either end raises.
reference: D61: a cast from microseconds to nanoseconds raises `overflow` when the result leaves 64 bits.

evidence.observed: ok, ERR ConversionException, ok, ERR ConversionException

provenance.notes: Probed at both ends and one past each.
